svg.text: Study004 / the same routed unit supports one square and rejects another
Measured per-square score bookkeeping. Scores are full-set membership signals, not probabilities or move preferences.
A and B are concrete fork examples, NOT a matched causal pair. All eight output-lane paths are retained; lane5 was training-selected for E2.h2. One path is not the whole expert.
A / #49 test / Fork square loses membership
observations of this board, not a
Lesion effects are NOT additive contributions.
B / #170 test / Fork counterexample retains membership
observations of this board, not a
Lesion effects are NOT additive contributions.
The SAME stored w2[2,2,5] feeds different final-head rows: head[0,5] is negative while head[4,5] is positive. Activity and gating also differ. A: lane5 supports square1 by
+47,587.29; B: it rejects square5 by -1,652.04. The latter is outweighed by other computations.
Green board outline marks the candidate, not the chosen preference. Orange/blue lane cells encode positive/negative dynamic support, normalized within each row; purple outlines mark the displayed
static path. Exact integer numerators and rounding residuals remain in exact-paths.json.
